questions.question: Let [latex]f(z)=\frac{az+b}{cz+d}[/latex] . If [latex]f(z_{1})=f(z_{2}) \; for \; all \; z_{1}\neq z_{2}[/latex] , a= 2, b = 4 and c= 5, then d should be equal to _______.

condition
